text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for hosted-inference-eu-west — service: inference-prod — symptom: 5xx spike on /v1/generate. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-12345. Auto-escalate in 2m if no ack.
priya: Oncall here, taking it. I'll triage now.
cameron: Thanks Priya. Any customer-facing errors reported by CS yet?
priya: CS reported timeouts. I see error rate ~12% and latency jump on the west cluster. Canary from last night still in traffic. Investigating.
anya: If rollback needs infra help, I can scale dedicated pool or drain nodes. Standby.
mike: I'm near the bridge, can handle traffic-split and temporary scaling.
priya: Starting rollback of canary: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-canary -n hosted-prod` — running now, ETA ~90s.
incident-bot: Runbook invoked: inference-5xx-spike by priya. Bridge created: https://zoom.example/bridge-3312 (auto-logged).
cameron: :thumbsup: please note for postmortem. Any KV-cache eviction spikes?
priya: No obvious evictions yet. Metrics show higher sequence-length distribution and a pod with OOM spikes around the same window.
anya: If rollback completes cleanly I'll drain node node-eu-west-07 for inspection.
mike: Applying temporary traffic-split 90% stable / 10% canary and scaling dedicated-pool +2 GPUs (policy=urgent-burst).
priya: Rollback finished — error rate down to ~1.5% and p50 latency normalizing. Closing temporary split.
cameron: Nice work. Priya — can you capture a short timeline and estimated customer impact (minutes degraded, affected orgs)? CS wants a succinct blurb.
priya: Timeline captured in incident doc. Impact: ~7 minutes of degraded responses for ~3% of traffic; CS notified affected customers. Will follow up with detailed timeline in the postmortem.
mike: Monitoring for stabilization for 10 more minutes, then I'll remove the extra GPUs.
anya: I'll keep the drained node isolated until we've checked logs and kernel OOMs.
priya: Marking incident as resolved in PagerDuty but keeping bridge open for 15m for monitoring. Thanks everyone. :wave:
incident-bot: Incident status updated: RESOLVED (trigger: priya). Logs and actions linked to INC-12345.
priya: Adding action items: (1) add sequence-length alert, (2) review canary rollout config for memory spike, (3) schedule postmortem doc.
cameron: Agreed. I'll own the postmortem write-up.
priya: Thanks — closing thread after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
